analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the indexed threat model and selected T-041 detail. CI removes only the console routing lane and Console UI Lint & Build job (ci.yml base 37, 637–658); component-changes.yml removes the console outputs (base 8–9, 22). The remaining provider selection and fail-closed aggregate gate are intact (ci.yml head 569–591), as are provider/native, attestation, cache and release-integrity checks. Read-only workflow permissions are unchanged. No supplied change modifies serving authorization, cryptographic custody, prompt handling, billing or local availability controls associated with TB-002/TB-003/TB-007/TB-011/TB-012 and T-041.
AGENTS.md head 17–20, 45–62 and CONTRIBUTING.md patch remove retained-console ownership/tooling references and relocate the telemetry mirror contract to the platform; these are documentation changes, not executable authorization. Release qualification, plaintext-endpoint caveats and coordinated protocol review remain explicit. No concrete security regression is established by removing tests for an out-of-scope console snapshot.
Integration should reconcile this batch with console-source/tooling retirement and any other changed consumers of the removed workflow output, particularly whether removed console fixture tests supplied provider-contract coverage that must be retained elsewhere. Those migration relationships are not established by this source batch. No deployment cutover or missing platform control is inferred, and existing runner/cache behavior is not treated as newly introduced.
